CustomField.label: Email Key
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set by OutreachEmailKey.normalise. Do not edit by hand.
CustomField.description: Normalised recipient address. Unique so that two reps confirming overlapping batches in the same second cannot both claim the same person: the platform rejects the second insert with DUPLICATE_VALUE. A query is not a substitute for this constraint. Case insensitive because normalisation already lowercases, and belt and braces is cheap here.
